blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro on Wednesday laughed off Vice President Sara Duterte’s call for the Marcos administration to “start working and stop politicking.” Duterte had accused the government of attempting to bring her down by linking her to a business venture allegedly involving Chinese funding and a drug bust in Laos supposedly connected to a Mindanao-Davao conspiracy. READ: Sara Duterte: Gov’t using Laos travel, China issues to ‘take me down’ Duterte also questioned the circulation of a purported travel authority for her supposed trip to Laos on September 29 to 30, which the Office of the Executive Secretary […]...
